DEAR COUNTY DIRECTOR OF SOCIAL SERVICES
ATTENTION: Child Support Managers and Supervisors
SUBJECT: County Quarterly Report and Narrative

Please find attached the County Quarterly Report and Narrative. These reports provide an overview of each county's performance measures for the second quarter of State Fiscal Year 2024 (SFY2024). The reports are distributed each quarter to provide the county a measurable gauge of each performance standard.
Should you have questions or need additional information, please contact Debbie Henderson at (919) 855-4455, or your Regional Continuous Quality Improvement Specialist.
